content.text: Cedarvale Park is already on your week for Saturday soccer practice at 10:00am. I couldn't find a standalone park to point you to. The closest thing I have is Riverdale Farm, a free outdoor farm open daily, which is a farm and not a park. It's on Sun, Aug 9. [link-b8b9f6] I'll look again for parks and playgrounds and text you what I find within a day.
